title: Saul Tries to Kill David

questions.question: Who warned David that Saul wanted to kill him?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:2 (ESV): “And Jonathan told David, ‘Saul my father seeks to kill you...’...”

questions.question: Who helped David escape through a window?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:12 (ESV): “So Michal let David down through the window, and he fled away and escaped.”

questions.question: What did Michal put in David’s bed to deceive the messengers?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:13 (ESV): “Michal took an image and laid it on the bed and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head...”

questions.question: Where did David flee to first?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:18 (ESV): “Now David fled and escaped, and he came to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him.”

questions.question: What happened to Saul’s messengers when they saw the prophets prophesying?
options: The Spirit of God came upon them, and they also prophesied
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit of God came upon them, and they also prophesied
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:20 (ESV): “...the Spirit of God came upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.”

questions.question: What happened when Saul himself went to Ramah?
options: He stripped off his clothes and prophesied
questions.correctAnswer: He stripped off his clothes and prophesied
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:24 (ESV): "And he too stripped off his clothes, and he too prophesied before Samuel and lay naked all that day and all that night."

questions.question: What lie did Michal tell Saul when he asked why she let David go?
options: He said to me, "Let me go. Why should I kill you?"
questions.correctAnswer: He said to me, "Let me go. Why should I kill you?"
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:17 (ESV): "...Michal answered Saul, 'He said to me, "Let me go. Why should I kill you?"'"

questions.question: How many groups of messengers did Saul send before going himself?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:20-21 (ESV): Describes three groups of messengers being sent.

questions.question: Where did Samuel and David dwell?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:18 (ESV): "...And he and Samuel went and lived at Naioth."

questions.question: What weapon did Saul throw at David again in this chapter?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:10 (ESV): "Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he eluded Saul..."

questions.question: Saul swore to Jonathan, "As the Lord lives, he shall not be put to ______."
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:6 (ESV): "And Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan. Saul swore, 'As the LORD lives, he shall not be put to death.'"

questions.question: Where is the great well (cistern) that Saul came to?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:22 (ESV): "Then he himself went to Ramah and came to the great well that is in Secu..."

questions.question: What saying is repeated at the end of this chapter?
options: Is Saul also among the prophets?
questions.correctAnswer: Is Saul also among the prophets?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:24 (ESV): "...Thus it is said, 'Is Saul also among the prophets?'"

questions.question: Who was standing as head over the company of prophets?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:20 (ESV): "...and Samuel standing as head over them..."

questions.question: What prompted the harmful spirit to come upon Saul again?
options: While he was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand and David was playing the lyre
questions.correctAnswer: While he was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand and David was playing the lyre
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 19:9 (ESV): "Then a harmful spirit from the LORD came upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand. And David was playing the lyre."

key_verse_text: So Michal let David down through the window, and he fled away and escaped. (ESV)
